Do not make any change.

Monitor PaymentIntent pi_new. Complete only when Stripe records the exact ID as succeeded, currency usd, amount_received exactly 4200 cents, and customer cus_new. A processing intent is insufficient. This concerns recorded API state, not independent bank settlement.

Monitor release 202 in cli/cli. Complete only when its recorded ID is 202, tag_name is v3.2.1, draft is false, prerelease is false, and target_commitish equals the supplied SHA exactly. This is release metadata, not independent verification of deployed software or resolving a branch name to a commit.

Monitor check run 501 in cli/cli. Complete only for ID 501, head_sha matching the supplied SHA, status completed and conclusion success. A queued check or another check run's success is insufficient. Do not create, rerun or modify a check.

Using an authorized standard Slack Web API token, monitor directory record U1234567890. Complete only if its exact ID matches, deleted is false, is_bot is false and team_id is T1234567890. This is Slack directory state, not proof that a person is currently working or reading messages. Do not change the user profile.

Using only Stripe's standard PaymentIntent API, prove that a succeeded PaymentIntent pi_new can never be disputed, refunded, reversed or otherwise lose its economic value in the future. An API status snapshot alone is insufficient. Do not make a payment or change anything.
